interface.name: polly_shortcuts_v1

description.summary: trusted shortcut configuration and switcher presentation

interface.description: Only the compositor-owned Shell connection may bind this interface. Actions are a fixed catalog, not commands or executable strings. The compositor owns switcher selection and commits it when the trigger modifiers are released. The Shell presents bounded display labels. Version 2 requires the ten-action catalog: the original seven numeric actions retain their order, followed by tile-left, tile-right and restore-floating. Version 1 bindings are rejected, not partially applied. Version 3 adds bounded compositor-owned window previews. Version 2 retains its original title-only presenter and ten-action catalog. Version 4 adds native perspective/depth composition. It does not change the version-3 rectangle format or grant foreign pixels to the presenter. Version 5 adds opt-in native four-workspace cube policy and status.

request.name: commit

description.summary: validate and atomically apply staged bindings

request.description: Validation failure leaves all existing bindings unchanged.

request.name: recording

description.summary: allow a focused Shell layer to record a chord

request.description: Suppression applies only while a Shell layer has keyboard focus. It ends with this resource's destruction.

request.name: configure_previews

description.summary: paint current candidate thumbnails in an owned selector surface

request.description: Only the current authenticated Shell presenter may request this while its exact switcher serial is active. Request IDs increase strictly. Surface must be an owned, mapped and arranged overlay on an enabled output, with a current matching buffer, fixed dimensions, no keyboard interactivity and exclusive zone -1; its logical extent is at most 4096x768. This is not an input or window-placement grant. Rectangles contain one to nine sets of five uints: candidate index, surface-local x/y and logical width/height. Indices are unique, boxes fit the actual surface, and each is at most 512x320. Background is RGB. No foreign surface or pixel FD is accepted or returned. Failure preserves the previous presentation. Individual unavailable source/resource slots are reported through the ready bitmask and visible error rather than disguised as live images. Previews stop on selector close, owner loss, locking or target retirement.

arg.name: ready
arg.summary: bit per requested rectangle, not candidate index

request.name: configure_projection

description.summary: compose a bounded native 3D window stack

request.description: Uses the same current-presenter, serial, monotonic request and owned selector requirements as configure_previews. Viewport contains exactly five uints: animate (0/1), surface-local x/y and logical width/height. The compositor chooses up to nine actual candidate sources and camera geometry. Pixels, source buffers and transforms are not exposed. The existing previews_status ready mask uses bit zero for this single composed viewport. Source failures are explicitly reported.

request.name: pick_projection

description.summary: read-only depth-consistent hit test of the current native stack

request.description: Coordinates are logical pixels relative to the configured viewport. The current composed pose is used, not an uncommitted animation goal. A miss returns UINT32_MAX and an empty error. Stale or invalid requests return an explicit error. This request does not activate a window.

request.name: configure_cube

description.summary: atomically select native workspace switching policy

request.description: Enabled and motion are strict booleans (0/1). Enabling requires the paired GLES renderer and exactly four workspaces. Failure preserves policy. Configuration cancels an active selection without activation. Sources remain compositor-owned and hidden workspaces are not activated to sample them. Release the triggering modifiers to commit; Escape cancels. Owner loss, lock, grabs and output/workspace changes cancel.
